title: Maikura Exploration Tools
description: Advanced structure exploration tools for Minecraft Fabric.
body:
# Maikura Exploration Tools

Explore the world more efficiently with advanced exploration tools.

Maikura Exploration Tools is a utility mod for Minecraft Fabric that helps players locate nearby structures, containers, spawners, and exploration targets through visual scanning and guidance systems.

The mod provides an easy-to-use exploration scanner with adjustable search distances, multiple scanning modes, and category filters. Players can customize what they want to search for and quickly identify points of interest while exploring.

## Features

* Exploration Scanner tool
* Adjustable search distance (16, 32, 48, and 64 blocks)
* Multiple exploration modes
* Right-click mode switching
* Category filtering
* Container detection
* Spawner detection
* Resource target detection
* Entity-related target detection
* Visual exploration guidance
* Survival-friendly design
* Lightweight design

## Compatibility

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
